headline: UK Chancellor John Healey Prepares Autumn Budget Under Borrowing Constraints
summary: UK Chancellor John Healey faces tightening fiscal constraints from recent inflation and public borrowing figures as he prepares to present the government's tax and spending budget on October 28.
why: UK budget decisions determine gilt issuance volumes, fiscal deficits, and taxation frameworks that directly affect sterling assets and sovereign bond yields.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: Elevated borrowing figures constrain fiscal flexibility and raise questions over upcoming tax policy changes.
